name: – Andrzej Halicki – Before § 1 – Am 6
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: -1c. Calls for the EU’s long-term budget to encourage the full harnessing of the development potential of each country, through public investment, by supporting and modernising productive and strategic sectors, investing in and boosting the efficiency of public services, creating jobs with rights and promoting full employment, working to eradicate poverty, combating social exclusion and inequality, conserving and restoring ecosystems, mitigating and adapting to climate change, and seeking to forge external relations rooted in solidarity, cooperation, mutual respect and peace;
